subject: Missing checklist before Thursday
text: The vendor compliance checklist is still missing from the shared folder, and I need it before the budget conversation Thursday. Sorry if this overlaps with what was said in standup, but I cannot find the latest file, and the notes seem to point to a version from last cycle rather than this one. If pulling the full checklist is difficult right now, we could try an alternative that might be enough for now: a short list of the remaining open questions, the owners, and any blockers, with a link to the current evidence. That would let me flag the risk early instead of discovering gaps later. Please also mention if the document is waiting on a signature or a scope confirmation, because I can ask for that separately and keep the thread cleaner. No need to format anything beautifully. A rough outline in the reply is fine. If someone already has it attached elsewhere, just forward the most current copy so we do not compare old assumptions against newer notes. I was also thinking we could start with one page, but if that feels like extra work, bullet points are acceptable. Thanks.
